question: In cricket, ________ is called by the umpire when the bowler doesn’t deliver the ball within reach of the batter.
solution:
The correct answer is __**wide**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Wide** is called by the **umpire in cricket **when the bowler doesn't deliver the ball within reach of the batter.
 
• A wide ball is one that is judged by the umpire to be too wide or too high for the batter to hit.
 
• If a bowler bowls a wide, the batting side is awarded one extra run</str
